grammar.summary: 本课介绍残钞鉴别组，运用 needn't 表示「不必」、so long as 引导条件状语从句，以及 whose 引导的定语从句交代人物关系；同时出现 have sth done（钱包被煮）与时间状语从句中的过去完成时。

points.title: needn't 不必 (Modal: needn't)
points.explanation: needn't + 动词原形，表示「没有必要做某事」，need 此处为情态动词，多用于否定句。本课用 needn't despair 告诉英国人「犯这种错误时不必绝望」。

examples.en: People who live in Britain needn't despair when they made mistakes like this (and a lot of people do)!
examples.cn: 当英国人犯这种错误时，他们不必感到绝望（而许多国家的人都有这种绝望的感觉）。

points.title: so long as 条件状语从句 (Condition with so long as)
points.explanation: so long as = as long as，引导条件状语从句，意为「只要……就……」，强调主句成立的条件。本课银行发言人用 so long as there's something to identify 表示「只要有东西可供识别，我们就会把钱还给人家的」。

examples.en: 'So long as there's something to identify, we will give people their money back,' said a spokeswoman for the Bank.
examples.cn: “只要有东西可供识别，我们会把钱还给人家的，”银行的一位女发言人说。

points.title: whose 引导定语从句 (Relative clause with whose)
points.explanation: whose 在定语从句中作定语，表示「某人的/某物的」，引导定语从句说明所属关系。本课用 whose fiancé, John, runs a successful furniture business 修饰 Jane Butlin，交代她与未婚夫约翰的关系。

examples.en: A recent case concerns Jane Butlin whose fiancé, John, runs a successful furniture business.
examples.cn: 最近的一个案例与简.巴特林有关，她的未婚夫约翰拥有一家生意兴隆家具店。

exercises.q: People who live in Britain ______ despair when they made mistakes like this.
______ there's something to identify, we will give people their money back.
A recent case concerns Jane Butlin ______ fiancé, John, runs a successful furniture business.
用否定情态动词填空：People who live in Britain ______ despair when they made mistakes like this.（写出否定情态动词，连写）
